origins.description: This input defines the implementation shape, MANUAL marker grammar, sealed-binding delegation contract on the ruled vocabulary. Not historical truth.

legalDomain.manualMarkers: Exact four-space comment lines '// ==== BEGIN MANUAL ====' and '// ==== END MANUAL ===='; exactly one pair per override method; BEGIN sits on the line after the def opening brace, the sealed-binding delegation body on the single following line, END followed by the method closing brace. Pairing is pinned as a structural property with a directed negative.
legalDomain.sealedBinding: Each MANUAL body seals one tool binding: the pinned script constant, the business argument (sku.value) or the empty argument, the timeout budget, and the typed lifting through the gate companion decode. The gate face never exposes script, process or timeout vocabulary; callers pass business values only.
legalDomain.delegationContract: Exactly one runner call per gate call; ProcessRequest(script, argument, timeoutMs) passed through verbatim — never escaped, rewritten, defaulted or trimmed; the raw output line is lifted through the companion decode into the typed result; no retry, no exception swallowing, no synthesized success.
legalDomain.failureChannels: A failed runner Future propagates unchanged as the gate call's failed Future; a runner failure thrown synchronously propagates out of the gate call itself unchanged (same exception instance, exactly one invocation recorded); a malformed runner output becomes a named ProtocolViolation on the failure channel through the codec; a refusal stays a typed value on the success channel.
legalDomain.runnerLib: LocalProcessRunner (infrastructure.process, handwritten fixed lib shared with the approved gate bundle, generator never creates it): argv-direct delivery, exclusive bounded lifecycle with kill, script-pinning hook; concrete spawn mechanics stay outside the gate's executable surface (sandbox denies process-exec) — gate coverage is compile plus seam-contract doubles (scripted queue and synchronous thrower), never a live process.
legalDomain.assembly: infrastructure.bootstrap.StockCatalogModule (frozen from the approved gate bundle) binds the gate to this implementation with an explicit Guice binding; the test seam module supplies runner and ExecutionContext instances.
legalDomain.unusedSlot: The raw no-helper branch (defaultBody '???') is a synchronous unimplemented slot, not a constructed failed Future; its generated shape is deferred to generator-phase fixtures and is not claimed by this sample.
